find: const bases = await resolveBaseCommits(run_host, repo_path, base)
rationale: Round 9's load-bearing change, re-pointed off round 8's target as the contract requires. A committed nomination is only a nomination if the branch actually WROTE it, and that membership test is only as honest as the base it is measured from: a local base ref that has fallen behind the remote puts a predecessor's merged nomination inside the range, so a reused branch name inherits it and the gate proves the earlier round's mutation against this round's work (reproduced against real git). Resolving the base to every commit it names, and requiring the blob in EVERY resulting diff, is what closes that. Restoring the bare name reopens exactly the fail-open hole: the scripted stale-base case and the real-git clone case go red, while the prover suite, which never reads a committed nomination, stays green.
